newsitem.title: USA: American Express annuity offers 10 percent. [CORRECTED 22:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: American Express annuity offers 10 percent. [CORRECTED 22:10 GMT]

text.p: American Express Co said its new Financial Direct Privileged Assets annuity will offer a 10 percent first-year yield in most U.S. states.
In New York, the yield will be 6.5 percent, due to N.Y. state insurance regulations that limit the amount of bonus yield that a company can offer.
The yields are based on a 5.5 percent base yield in New York and a five percent base yield in all other U.S. states (Corrects to specify which base yields apply to which states.)
American Express said the annuity is being targeted especially to its charge card holders, with a minimum investment of $50 per month.
The annuity is a tax-deferred retirement savings plan.
Financial Direct is a unit of American Express. (corrects fact that Financial Direct does not have $140 billion in owned or managed assets).
